files_modified.behavior_after: Agent A SKILL SET: EP group analysis. Covers all 5 groups (A1 ajax_nopriv, A2 ajax_priv, A3 rest_route, A4 shortcode_block, A5 misc). Context: IR guarantees (is_effective semantics), trust-but-verify discipline. Input: ir-slice + source + semgrep + threat-context + output schema. Tasks: read IR → read source → trace → check guards (null = verify manually) → refute → verdict. Output rules: TP requires entry_point_id + source/sink file:line + reasoning; FP requires fp_reason + fp_evidence; REVIEW requires review_reason (why uncertain + what resolves). Deploy-order-critical note: prompts must require review_reason before activating schema validation. Scope: no cross-EP, no anomalies, no unresolved hooks.

Agent B SKILL SET: stored/cross-EP flows. Context: 2-hop pattern (store leg + load leg), IR-07 fix guarantees. Input: full IR + source + output schema. Tasks: map writes → map reads → match by key → verify attacker reachability → check sanitization at both legs → output findings. Critical rules: entry_point_id MUST = load_entry_point_id (gate uses this for file/path checks); store_entry_point_id = write-leg EP; storage_key required when literal; write-leg auth level must appear in reasoning. Scope: cross-EP flows only. Gate Validation Coverage section (added post-session via commit 083e8fd): gate validates write-leg auth (nonce+cap), load-leg nonce/cap, key matching, schema compliance. Gate does NOT validate load-leg output escaping (DI-19-02 — Phase 1 extractor does not emit output_escaping guard type; phase3_gate.py:799-804). Implication embedded: strong escaping evidence (verified file:line, e.g. bare echo with no esc_html) → TP defensible; ambiguous/inferred escaping → verdict REVIEW + confidence ≤ 0.5; do not assume gate will catch wrong escaping claim.

Agent C SKILL SET: anomaly deep dive. Context: AnomalyRules 10 deterministic rules (AST-level only, no exploitability check). All 10 anomaly types documented: missing_nonce (R01), missing_capability (R02), flawed_nonce_pattern (R03), unsanitized_sql (R04), potential_xss (R05), is_admin_as_auth (R06), rest_return_true (R07), nopriv_sensitive_op (R08), unsafe_redirect (R09), inconsistency (R10). Input: anomalies from IR + source at evidence.file:line. Tasks: read source → check defenses → verdict. Rules: one anomaly = one finding; do NOT discover new findings outside anomalies list; quick focused sessions (5-20 anomalies typical). Common FP patterns documented for each rule.

Agent D SKILL SET: unresolved hooks + coverage gaps. Context: IR-01 logs but Agent D resolves. Input: unresolved_hooks + coverage_gaps from IR + source + output schema. Tasks: trace dynamic hook expressions (concatenation, class constants, method returns) → if resolved analyze like Agent A → write full IR supplement; for coverage gaps classify reason → find vulnerability → REVIEW by default. Rules: resolved_dynamic:<hash> as entry_point_id (hash = sha1(file+':'+line+':'+resolved_hook_literal)); MUST write to reports/phase1/<slug>-ir-supplement.json with FULL format (entry_points+sources+sinks+guards — entry_points-only is insufficient); confidence levels (high/medium/low); sessions 5-15 hooks; assumptions explicit.
